description: Algemene ontwerprichtlijnen Riolering is a dataset listed in den-haag-opendata open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by den-haag-opendata. Gemeenten zijn primair verantwoordelijk voor de aanleg en beheer van de riolering. De leidraad riolering van de Stichting Rioned is een door de gemeente gehanteerd ondersteunend instrument voor de aanleg en beheer van de riolering. In aanvulling op de Leidraad geldt dit programma van technische eisen. Publicatie t.b.v. test Handboek Openbare Ruimte. Coverage: The Hague. The portal files it under Space and infrastructure. The portal shows 2026-03-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-den-haag-opendata-portal.
